message.content:
**Miami’s primary passenger‑rail stop** | Train | Location | Pet Policy | |-------|----------|------------| | **Amtrak – Silver Meteor / Silver Star** | *Miami Amtrak Station*
2000 NW 2nd Ave., Miami, FL 33126 | • Small dogs & cats permitted **only when confined to an approved travel crate/Carrier**.
• Must stay within the “Pet Area” of the platform and cannot roam freely.
• No separate pet lounge—pets remain on the platform until boarding.
• Additional fees apply for larger animals or those traveling outside the designated area.* If your definition of “train station” includes commuter rail, note: - **Tri-Rail** does not operate in Miami proper; its nearest stop is West Palm Beach (~1 hour away). Tri‑Rail has similar restrictions: pets may ride only in a carrier and must be kept under control while waiting for the train. --- ### Quick Tips If You’re Traveling With Your Furry Friend 1. **Check the latest rules before departure:** Policies can change, especially regarding COVID‑19 protocols or new safety regulations. 2. **Book early:** Some services require advance notification for pets so staff can prepare accommodations. 3. **Bring essentials:** A comfortable carrier, leash, water bowl, and some treats will make the journey smoother. Let me know if you’d like help finding alternative transportation options around Miami that are more pet‑friendly!
